title: My fridge light blinked a number every night 🧊
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:21 in the morning my fridge light blinked eleven times.

scenes.narration: At 3:21 in the morning my fridge light blinked eleven times.
I stood in the kitchen doorway in the dark. The fridge door was shut. The light inside should not even have been on.
It blinked again. Eleven times, slow, like somebody counting. Then it stopped, and the kitchen was silent.
The next night it blinked at the same time. Eleven times. I wrote the number on a sticky note and stuck it on the door.
On the third night I counted twelve. The night after that, thirteen. I realised it was not counting blinks. It was counting down the rooms.
My flat has fourteen rooms, if you count the cupboards. I never had. But when I walked through each one with a torch, I found something in every one.
A small mark on every wall, at the height of my shoulder. Fourteen marks, each one made by a thumb, each one still warm.
Tonight the light blinked once. Then a voice behind the fridge door whispered, you are the last room, and opened it.
So tell me. Do you look inside the fridge, or run for the door?
